# google_dataplex_metadata_feed

A Metadata Feed represents a metadata feed in Dataplex.



## Example Usage - Dataplex Metadata Feed Basic


```hcl
resource "google_pubsub_topic" "test_topic" {
  name = "metadata-feed-topic"
}

resource "google_project_service_identity" "dataplex_identity" {
  project  = "my-project-name"
  service  = "dataplex.googleapis.com"
}

resource "google_pubsub_topic_iam_member" "dataplex_publisher" {
  topic  = google_pubsub_topic.test_topic.name
  role   = "roles/pubsub.publisher"
  member = "serviceAccount:${google_project_service_identity.dataplex_identity.email}"
}

resource "google_pubsub_topic_iam_member" "dataplex_viewer" {
  topic  = google_pubsub_topic.test_topic.name
  role   = "roles/pubsub.viewer"
  member = "serviceAccount:${google_project_service_identity.dataplex_identity.email}"
}

resource "google_dataplex_metadata_feed" "test_metadata_feed" {
  metadata_feed_id = "metadata-feed-basic"
  project = "my-project-name"
  location = "us-central1"
  scope {
    organization_level = true
  }
  pubsub_topic = google_pubsub_topic.test_topic.id

  depends_on = [
    google_pubsub_topic_iam_member.dataplex_publisher,
    google_pubsub_topic_iam_member.dataplex_viewer,
  ]
}

```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `scope` -
  (Required)
  Scope defines the scope of the metadata feed.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_scope).


* `labels` -
  (Optional)
  User-defined labels for the MetadataFeed.

  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

* `filters` -
  (Optional)
  Filters defines the type of changes that you want to listen to.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_filters).

* `pubsub_topic` -
  (Optional)
  The pubsub topic that you want the metadata feed messages to publish to.

* `location` -
  (Optional)
  The location where metadata feed will be created in.

* `metadata_feed_id` -
  (Optional)
  The metadata feed id of the metadata feed.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_scope"></a>The `scope` block supports:

* `organization_level` -
  (Optional)
  Whether the metadata feed is at the organization-level.

* `projects` -
  (Optional)
  The projects whose entries you want to listen to. Must be in the same organization as the feed. Must be in the format: projects/{project_id_or_number}.

* `entry_groups` -
  (Optional)
  The entry groups whose entries you want to listen to. Must be in the format: projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{location_id}/entryGroups/{entry_group_id}.

<a name="nested_filters"></a>The `filters` block supports:

* `entry_types` -
  (Optional)
  The entry types that you want to listen to.

* `aspect_types` -
  (Optional)
  The aspect types that you want to listen to.

* `change_types` -
  (Optional)
  The type of change that you want to listen to.
  Each value may be one of: `CHANGE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED`, `CREATE`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/metadataFeeds/{{metadata_feed_id}}`

* `name` -
  The relative resource name of the MetadataFeed, of the form: projects/{project_number}/locations/{location_id}/metadataFeeds/{metadata_feed_id}

* `uid` -
  System generated globally unique ID for the MetadataFeed. This ID will be different if the MetadataFeed is deleted and re-created with the same name.

* `create_time` -
  The time when the MetadataFeed was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time when the MetadataFeed was last updated.

* `terraform_labels` -
  The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
   and default labels configured on the provider.

* `effective_labels` -
  All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 5 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 5 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 5 minutes.

## Import


MetadataFeed can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/metadataFeeds/{{metadata_feed_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{metadata_feed_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{metadata_feed_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import MetadataFeed using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-optional value->"
    metadataFeedId = "<-optional value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_dataplex_metadata_feed.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import MetadataFeed using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/metadataFeeds/{{metadata_feed_id}}"
  to = google_dataplex_metadata_feed.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), MetadataFeed can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_dataplex_metadata_feed.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/metadataFeeds/{{metadata_feed_id}}
$ terraform import google_dataplex_metadata_feed.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{metadata_feed_id}}
$ terraform import google_dataplex_metadata_feed.default {{location}}/{{metadata_feed_id}}
```
